answer: Put \(m=\binom n2\), \(N=2^m\), \(B=N+1\), \(D=n^{n-2}\), and \(Q=\operatorname{lcm}(1,2,\ldots,D)\). For \(0\le i<j<n\), set \(\rho(i,j)=i(2n-i-1)/2+j-i-1\). For each \(0\le s<N\), define \(a_{ii}(s)=0\) and \(a_{ij}(s)=a_{ji}(s)=\lfloor s/2^{\rho(i,j)}\rfloor-2\lfloor s/2^{\rho(i,j)+1}\rfloor\). Set \(d_i(s)=\sum_j a_{ij}(s)\) and \(L_s=\operatorname{diag}(d_0(s),\ldots,d_{n-1}(s))-(a_{ij}(s))\). Writing \(M[I]\) for the principal submatrix on \(I\), define \(T_s=\det L_s[\{1,\ldots,n-1\}]\), \(F_s=\det L_s[\{2,\ldots,n-1\}]\), \(h_s=\lfloor1/(T_s+1)\rfloor\), \(r_s=\left\lfloor1/\left(1+\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(d_i(s)-d_0(s))^2\right)\right\rfloor\), and \(e_s=Qd_0(s)F_s r_s(1-h_s)/(T_s+h_s)\). Then throughout the stated domain, \[\boxed{t_n=\frac nQ\left\lfloor\log_{\,2^{\binom n2}+1}\left(\sum_{s=0}^{2^{\binom n2}-1}\bigl(2^{\binom n2}+1\bigr)^{e_s}\right)\right\rfloor.}\]
